brief:
Avigdor Lieberman's appointment to lead the Knesset's Foreign Affairs and Security Committee prompted the former defense minister to announce plans to summon military leaders, including the army's chief of staff, Shehab Wire reported. Lieberman did not detail the purpose of the summoning or specific topics he intends to address with the commanders.

The hardline politician now controls parliamentary oversight of security and diplomatic affairs.
